name: carbon-arc-location-intelligence
description: Two reports, using Carbon Arc data. A place report: how a metro area's economy is doing against comparable metro areas, or what a dated shock such as a storm or a plant closure did to it, read from two sides: what the people who live there spend and on what, and what happens at its locations. And a venue report: how an arena, stadium or theater's ticket market is doing against comparable venues, which shows and games drive it, and what its events do to the blocks around it.
